My great-grandfather was a musician. In the era when the world lost its color, he inspired people with music.
But music that heals the soul cannot defeat hunger.
He collapsed.
He only came around after a perfumer fed him sweet nectar.
Later, unable to refuse her request, he inherited her legacy and became a perfumer himself.
He felt trapped in a place without wind.
...
Long after, he decided he had had enough and ran all the way to a cliff.
Back then, Argent Strait was still colorless, untouched by the Guardian’s grace like Bloomville.
Crescendo Cliff was ravaged by endless gales, and was known as the "Deadland of a Thousand Winds."
Yet in this deadland, my great-grandfather met some Chirpis singing in the wind.
So they sang loudly together... Even the wind couldn’t take their souls.
They were free.
They sang of freedom.
...
Years later, the Guardian returned green to the land, and Argent Strait revived.
On Crescendo Cliff, my great-grandfather twined with a Chirpi, flying and singing in the fresh wind.
This song gave birth to the Bell of Freedom.
It brought freedom, and a great wind leading to distant places.
...
My great-grandfather passed the perfumer’s legacy to my grandmother.
He was truly free.
They say he rode the great wind to where he wanted to go.
I envy him.
...
If only Flutternyms could fly across the sea.
My partner and I have always thought so.
If only there was a great wind leading far away.
I think, riding that wind, we could find freedom.
...
Now, the wind is here.
